# HTTP/2 multiplexing

HTTP/2 multiplexes many requests over one TCP connection. Some authors still recommend domain sharding for HTTP/2 because it opens more parallel TCP connections.
rationale: article discusses HTTP/2 domain sharding — same topic as http2-multiplexing

critic.reason: article argues domain sharding remains best practice; existing entry states sharding is no longer necessary and hurts performance
